results.description:
He needs a fake fiancée.
Unfortunately, he’s decided he wants me.
Ace Ambrose is the playboy captain of the Harrisburg Hawks. I’m the Blue Line Matchmaker who fixes hockey players’ love lives—including his.
But when he rejects every woman I recommend and offers me two million dollars to play his perfect fiancée, I do what any sensible businesswoman would do.
I accept the contract.
Two weeks with his family. One fake engagement. And very clear rules: no kissing, no hooking up, and absolutely no falling in love.
Until Ace looks at me like I belong to him.
Suddenly, I’m in serious trouble.
Because somewhere along the way, my heart has stopped treating this like a contract…
And our fake engagement is feeling dangerously real.
This is book 1 in the brand-new small town hockey romance series, Blue Line Matchmaking, by USA Today Bestselling Author, Elise Faber.
